generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: authentic-looking but clearly independent premium dealer-preview logo proposal, transparent PNG master.
Primary request: refined original website logo for the exact dealership name "Style Motors", no slogans.
Concept: sculpt a sleek custom SM typographic ligature with one slanted terminal that gives fashionable forward motion; matching airy editorial wordmark "Style Motors" that remains clear at small size. Urban car retailer with genuine design taste.
Style: restrained high-end automotive graphic identity, superb optical spacing, geometric yet warm flat vector.
Palette: midnight charcoal and a single desaturated electric-violet accent; solid inks.
Composition: complete emblem-and-wordmark lockup on genuinely transparent background, no background panel, safe margins, compact mark plausible at 32px.
Constraints: no car silhouette, steering wheel, wings, racing checkers, clipart, reflective chrome, textures, gradients, watermark or text other than "Style Motors". Independent website proposal; dealer not claimed to have accepted.

holdReasons: Genuine source branding not visually compared against concept
Separate compact mark and on-dark/accent variants incomplete
No maintained pack or six-design visual release checks
